title: Containerizing a Frontend Application knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the central idea of “Containerizing a Frontend Application”?
options: Plan health evidence, storage, secrets, logs, release identity, and tested recovery before deployment.
Deploy unpinned images and omit backups to keep the setup simple.
Assume restarting a container is the same as restoring lost data.
Remove the previous release before validating the replacement.
questions.answer_key: Plan health evidence, storage, secrets, logs, release identity, and tested recovery before deployment.
questions.explanation: Production operations need reproducibility and recovery evidence; a restart cannot replace a data backup.

questions.prompt: For a lab covering containerizing a frontend application, what is the strongest evidence of learning?
options: Assume the command is portable and skip reading its output.
Make several unrelated changes before collecting a baseline.
Use a production host so the result looks realistic.
Record the command or configuration, predicted result, observed evidence, and one relevant edge case.
questions.answer_key: Record the command or configuration, predicted result, observed evidence, and one relevant edge case.
questions.explanation: A useful lab connects a predicted result to actual output and checks an edge case. This is safer and more reproducible than assuming success.

questions.prompt: If an example related to containerizing a frontend application fails, which response is best?
options: Disable permissions or security controls until the example works.
Trust the image tag without inspecting the image or version.
Reproduce the issue, inspect state/logs/configuration, test one hypothesis at a time, and verify the fix.
Delete every stopped container and unused volume before investigating.
questions.answer_key: Reproduce the issue, inspect state/logs/configuration, test one hypothesis at a time, and verify the fix.
questions.explanation: The evidence-led approach keeps the diagnosis reproducible and avoids hiding the cause. For containerizing a frontend application, verify the fix with the exact setting or command that failed.
